name: magpie-cnb2api
description: CNB workspace's cnb2api gateway as a magpie provider: follows the drifting cnb.run subdomain, restarts the workspace when it stops, shows real quota, and supports multiple accounts.

summary.en: Runs cnb2api inside your own CNB workspace and follows its address: restarts the workspace when it stops, reads the new subdomain, serves it to agents as one provider.
summary.zh: 把你自己的 CNB 工作区里的 cnb2api 接成 magpie 供应商：地址变了自动跟随，工作区停了自动拉起。
